messages.content: Can you help? Should I skip insulin when I don't eat much?
I can't advise on medication—that needs to be your doctor. What I can do is log your glucose reading. You got one today?
Logged that 148. Your question about insulin adjustments is something a nurse can help with. Want me to escalate?
Nurse team usually gets back within about 31 hours. Your next regular check-in is in 7 days.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
